title: claim() NatSpec documents pay-then-skim with a direct claimer->phlimbo transfer; implementation skims-then-pays and routes claimer->this then nudge-split + phlimbo pull
violatedSpec: claim() @dev NatSpec flow block (contract L424-442 + interface IStableYieldAccumulator L314-336)
specText: Contract NatSpec (L426-434): '5. Transfer rewardToken FROM claimer TO phlimbo  6. skimSurplus each non-exempt strategy, sending the batched surplus ... TO the claimer'. Interface NatSpec (L315-323): '6. TransferFrom claimer to phlimbo  7. skimSurplus each non-exempt strategy ... to the claimer'.
actualBehavior: claim() executes the skimSurplus loop FIRST (L463-492, delivering all strategy yield to the claimer), THEN computes/collects payment (L497-520). Payment is NOT a direct claimer->phlimbo transfer: rewardToken is safeTransferFrom(claimer -> this contract) at L509, then split — nudgeAmount safeTransfer to `nudge` (L515-517) and phlimboAmount PULLED by phlimbo via IPhlimbo.collectReward (L518-519).
deviation: Two doc/impl mismatches in the same NatSpec flow block: (1) ORDERING — NatSpec pay precedes skim, but the code skims before it pays; (2) DESTINATION/MECHANISM (the F-01 EXTENSION over the pre-existing L-03 ordering drift) — NatSpec says 'transfer rewardToken FROM claimer TO phlimbo', but story-023's nudge split changed this to claimer->this contract followed by a nudge transfer and a phlimbo collectReward pull. The NatSpec was not updated when story-023 (nudge split) and story-025 (skimSurplus return-value pricing) reshaped the flow.
consequence: Documentation/spec-conformance only. No security or value impact: the skims-then-pays ordering is atomic (nonReentrant + whenNotPaused; any later revert rolls back the skims), and payment is derived from the actual underlyingReceived the claimer received in the same tx, so value conservation holds (PARK-02 confirms atomicity). Risk is reader/integrator confusion — a developer trusting the NatSpec would expect CEI pay-before-deliver and a direct phlimbo transfer, neither of which is what the contract does.
recommendation: Correct the claim() NatSpec (L424-442) and the interface comment (L314-336) to reflect skim-then-pay ordering AND the claimer->this->{nudge, phlimbo-pull} payment routing. Sub-QA related: lib/stable-yield-accumulator/CLAUDE.md Claim Example (L30-45) predates the nudge feature and assumes nudgeSplit==0 — same doc-drift family, not separately ledgered.
